gloss: to not back down an inch; to not give any ground

definitions.gloss: to not back down an inch; to not give any ground; to stand firm
definitions.explanation: To refuse to yield or retreat even slightly. Expresses determination and unwillingness to compromise or concede. Literally 'to not retreat even one step.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{引|ひ}かなかった→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: He didn't back down at all.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{両者|りょうしゃ}→両者：11357_ryousha⟧とも{一歩|いっぽ}も{引|ひ}かない⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: In the negotiations, both sides showed an unwillingness to give any ground.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信念|しんねん}→信念：03074_shinnen⟧⟦に{関|かん}して→に関して：06944_nikanshite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一歩|いっぽ}も{引|ひ}かない⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧だ。
examples.english: When it comes to my beliefs, I intend not to budge an inch.

notes:
Literally means 'to not retreat even one step.' A vivid expression that conveys firmness, determination, and refusal to yield.

USAGE:
Used in situations involving confrontation, debate, negotiation, or competition. Can describe either admirable resolve or stubborn inflexibility, depending on context.

FORMS:
- ⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{引|ひ}か→引く：01978_hiku⟧ず: continuative form — 'without backing down'
- ⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{引|ひ}けない→引く：01978_hiku⟧: potential negative — 'cannot afford to back down'
- ⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{譲|ゆず}らない→譲る：02323_yuzuru⟧: a close synonym — 'not concede even one step'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一歩|いっぽ}も{引|ひ}かない⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: an unyielding stance
- {一歩|いっぽ}も{引|ひ}かない{構|かま}え: a resolute posture
- {一歩|いっぽ}も{引|ひ}かない⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: an unwavering attitude

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頑|かたく}な→頑な：14627_katakuna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{譲|ゆず}らない→譲る：02323_yuzuru⟧: stubbornly refusing to concede — emphasizes stubbornness more
- ⟦{断固|だんこ}→断固：12714_danko⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: resolutely, firmly — an adverb with similar nuance
- ⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}けない→引く：01978_hiku⟧: cannot back down — implies being in too deep to retreat
